scheduling_note: Seed is recorded for local scheduling. Experiment order was chosen adaptively for discriminating evidence; no claim about model sampling determinism.
scope: One supplied account and origin; exploratory protocol pilot, no private tasks or formal scores.

budget_at_stop.learner_stop_reason: Contract stop after native UI click timeout in call018.

explored: Account menu, collection and wantlist views
Release84 metadata and persistent membership additions
Release84 marketplace listings, exact US/descending/rating99 filters
Cart adds, repeated quantity, checkout and sole-item removal
Seller unique release search and zero quantity validation
unexplored: Successful positive listing creation and listing deactivation/reactivation were not tested.
Zero-price backend acceptance/rejection is unknown; only disabled UI and timed-out click were observed.
Terminal write effect remains conservatively unconfirmed; the run stopped without a browser retry.
Anonymous and cross-account writes, sign-out, account-list removal and membership generalization are unknown.
Quantity ceilings, stock decrements, mixed currencies, multi-seller checkout, cancellation and fulfillment are unknown.
Artist/label/genre/community pages, most footer routes and search case/substring/pagination behavior were not explored.
Cookie settings/consent, newsletter subscription and account sign-out effects were not tested.
/add-release rendered 404 but no inference about unavailable backend business behavior is made.
Only 72/100 UI actions and 18/40 browser submissions were used because timeout required early stop.
The final reusable scripts and predictor were compiled and checked offline; no browser validation followed the stop.

current_competing_hypotheses.question: Do membership semantics generalize?
current_competing_hypotheses.distinguishing_experiment: In a future authorized/reset run, baseline a different release in both lists, add once, repeat after confirmation, compare separate list and fresh count.

current_competing_hypotheses.question: What price-zero backend behavior exists?
alternatives: Both UI and backend reject zero
current_competing_hypotheses.distinguishing_experiment: Only use a legitimate enabled rendered UI if discovered later; do not bypass disabled controls or call APIs.

current_competing_hypotheses.question: Can positive listing creation and lifecycle succeed?
alternatives: Further validation or account restrictions apply
current_competing_hypotheses.distinguishing_experiment: In a future run, exact selected release, positive price and quantity, single Create, inspect response/list/market before any follow-up; then deactivate once and read back.

current_competing_hypotheses.question: What happens at cart stock limits?
current_competing_hypotheses.distinguishing_experiment: Find UI-disclosed quantity/stock, baseline cart, add incrementally with persistent confirmation; stop on uncertainty.

resolved_competing_hypotheses.question: Membership repeated add toggles/duplicates versus stable target set?
resolved_competing_hypotheses.finding: Stable fresh membership/count for observed repeat; local counters misleading.

resolved_competing_hypotheses.question: Cart repeated exact listing idempotent versus quantity increment?

terminal_failure.cause: Helper checked uniqueness and visibility but not enabled; clicked disabled Create Listing.
terminal_failure.response: Preserved failure; stopped all browser submissions; final scripts add enabled-state guard.
